question: Smuggler's Share (each end step: draw a card for each opponent who drew two or more cards this turn; a Treasure for each who had two or more lands enter) in -- every symmetric wheel becomes three cards for us -- and for what?

contributions.text:
The deck doctor on study 028 (judged alone; NO CHANGE; only try run, one instrument, 10,000 paired games; it sees the card but not opponents' turns, the Treasure clause, blockers or removal).
Smuggler's Share pays only after one of our each-player draws, and jaws-v1 casts few (wheels cast by T10 1.77); most turns it is a 3-mana enchantment that does nothing. Opponents' extra-draw turns would fire it too: unmodelled, the case for the card, not shown.
- out Willie Lumpkin: killed by T6 17.3% -> 16.7% [-0.7, -0.4]; extra cards by T8 20.2 -> 19.3 [-1.0, -0.8]; damage @T10 -8.1 [-10.1, -6.1]; stall +1.1 pts [+0.8, +1.3]; 12 worse, 1 better.
- out Valeria Richards: killed by T6 -0.3 pts [-0.4, -0.1]; damage @T10 -6.5 [-8.5, -4.4]; finisher wheel by T8 -0.6 pts [-0.9, -0.4]; 6 worse, 2 better.
- out Wheel of Fortune: killed by T6 17.3% -> 14.6% [-3.0, -2.4]; finisher wheel by T8 60.2% -> 51.0% [-9.8, -8.6]; hoard @T10 -0.74 [-0.95, -0.54]; cutting a wheel removes what Share feeds on (stacks 009, 010 behind Wheel).
The screens did not decide it; the card's economics did: it needs each-player draws the deck rarely casts and does not advance "big, fast, consistent".
